title: Enterprise Connectivity: outage credit entitlement
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs outage credit entitlement for customer request, accountant review, credit.

## Policy clause 1
For a outage service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.

## Policy clause 2
For a outage service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than outage claim filing period after the official incident closes.

## Policy clause 3
For a newly filed claim, fixed current handling time is its filing time; the request is recorded immediately.

## Policy clause 4
Later review and credit use that recorded filing time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review.

## Policy clause 5
Add outage claim filing period UTC calendar dates to official incident closure time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods.

## Policy clause 6
Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit.

## Policy clause 7
The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside excluded incident causes.

## Policy clause 8
Availability at or above availability target percentage gives no credit.

## Policy clause 9
Below the target choose the first descending availability credit bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability percentage.

## Policy clause 10
Multiply the original source charge net service subtotal by that fraction; subtract the pretax outage credit component component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at cumulative outage credit ceiling fraction of that original net amount.

## Policy clause 11
Floor the additional credit at zero and round with monetary decimal places and rounding convention.

## Policy clause 12
Apply the original tax component proportionately.

## Policy clause 13
A review records its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit records the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists.

## Policy clause 14
This service-credit branch applies only to source classification outage service credit; invoice correction rules applies only to source classification correction.

## Policy clause 15
Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write.

## Policy clause 16
A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered.

## Policy clause 17
A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

## Evidence condition 1
For customer request, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: For a outage service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than outage claim filing period after the official incident closes. The evidence consists of evidence-event identifier, official incident closure time, filing time. Correlate the same evidence-event identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Calendar boundary
Add outage claim filing period UTC calendar dates to official incident closure time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. The authoritative anchor is official incident closure time when the official incident closes. At initial filing, compare the fixed handling time with this boundary. Later review and credit use the recorded filing time, preserving the same inclusive deadline.

## Hypothetical deadline case
A hypothetical claim filed exactly at the deadline meets the filing-time condition. A claim filed after that boundary fails it and is rejected without a credit. A timely recorded filing remains timely during a later review.

## Evidence condition 2
For credit, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: For a outage service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. The evidence consists of evidence-event identifier, source-event reference, status, decision, approved credit amount. Correlate the same source-event reference to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Outage accumulation
The pretax outage credit component is the absolute net service subtotal of outage service-credit postings for the exact original charge. It remains separate from the gross correction component and excludes unrelated charges.

## Points of judgement
A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the outage claim filing period, excluded incident causes, availability target percentage, availability credit bands, cumulative outage credit ceiling fraction, monetary decimal places, rounding convention used by this rule.
